fichas.title: Doors: standard dimensions and frame construction
fichas.summary: The sheet presents preferred modular wall-opening sizes for doors, a table comparing wall openings, door-panel dimensions and clear openings, and construction details for different door linings and frames. Modular dimensions for exceptional openings should be whole multiples of 125 mm, or 100 mm according to British Standards. Frame thickness and placement affect the clear opening; a shadow joint is recommended to help maintain the wall-to-frame junction over time.
